data.description:
## Summary

`resolve_project` (`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/projects_store.py`) collapses the
tri-state `bridge_project` field's **`None` "absent/legacy" sentinel** into the same branch as
the explicit `""` "never-sync" value, so a legacy ticket (no `bridge_project` flag) is
**suppressed from outbound create** instead of routing to `legacy_default`. This is the direct
cause of live DC rehearsal scenario 4 (`test_absent_project_resolves_to_legacy_default`) failing
with `assert 0 == 1` — the legacy-default ticket never lands in the legacy project.

## Proven root cause (rebar-debug Phase 1 complete)

`create_ticket` with no `bridge_project` stores `bridge_project: None` (present-but-null, seeded
by the reducer `_state.py:58`), NOT an absent key. `resolve_project`:

```python
if "bridge_project" not in ticket:      # DEAD for real tickets (key always present)
    return mapping.legacy_default
value = ticket["bridge_project"]
if not value:                            # None AND "" both hit this
    return None                          # <-- None wrongly suppressed
return value
```

The authoritative **cef7 tri-state contract** (`src/rebar/reducer/_state.py:53-58`) states
`bridge_project` is seeded `None` as the deliberate **"absent/legacy"** sentinel; `""` is the
explicit never-sync; a non-empty string is the sync target. `None` must route to
`legacy_default`. `resolve_project` violates this, and because the reducer ALWAYS materializes
the key, the `"bridge_project" not in ticket` branch is dead — `legacy_default` never fires for
the cohort it exists to serve. Confirmed original (not regression) via `git blame` `a22e6f3642`.

Runtime-confirmed: `resolve_project({"bridge_project": None}, ld="LEG")` → `None`
(vs. explicit `"LEG"` → `"LEG"`). The outbound create gate (`outbound_differ.py:584`)
`if not target: return` then drops the create → 0 landed → `assert 0 == 1`.

## Fix plan

Rewrite `resolve_project` to honor the tri-state explicitly:

```python
def resolve_project(ticket, mapping):
    value = ticket.get("bridge_project")
    if value is None:      # absent key OR the None absent/legacy sentinel
        return mapping.legacy_default or None
    if value == "":        # explicit never-sync
        return None
    return value
```

## Blast radius / caller-dependency sweep (gate CLEARED)

Single production caller: `outbound_differ.py:584` — the malfunctioning create gate itself,
which expects the contract-correct target. No existing test pins `None`->None; all existing
tests (`{}`->legacy_default, `""`->None, empty-legacy->None) stay green. The only behavior change
is the previously-untested `{"bridge_project": None}` case, changing toward the cef7 contract.
The outbound create is double-guarded: it fires only when the mapping is seeded AND
`legacy_default` is both set and a key in the mapping — i.e. exactly the designed cef7 legacy
migration. No behavioral dependency on the buggy path found; gate clears without user escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Held-out RED unit test: `resolve_project({"bridge_project": None}, ld=X) == X`, seen RED
   before the fix, GREEN after, teeth verified by defect-seeded mutation.
2. All existing `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_projects_store_*.py` and
   `tests/integration/test_ensure_project_mapping.py` stay green.
3. Scenario 4 strengthened with a meaningful `{legacy} <= _planned_projects(preview)` assertion
   (not just the vacuous empty-plan `_assert_scope`).
4. **A successful LIVE DC rehearsal run** (`test_multi_project_rehearsal.py`, all scenarios
   incl. scenario 4) passing in CI (`Live External Integration`) — the machinery must be
   proven end-to-end, not merely built.
5. Landed through Gerrit at `LLM-Review +1` AND `Verified +1`.
data.title: resolve_project collapses None absent/legacy sentinel into never-sync, suppressing legacy-default outbound create
